any2md.feature1.title: Converts locally, files never leave your machine
any2md.feature1.desc: The WASM engine runs inside your browser — documents are never uploaded. Zero outbound requests in DevTools Network, so sensitive files stay private.
any2md.feature2.title: All 13 formats supported
any2md.feature2.desc: Word, PPT, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF. The format is detected from file content, so even a mislabeled extension converts correctly.
any2md.feature3.title: Tables, footnotes and PPT notes preserved
any2md.feature3.desc: Merged cells, multi-line content, footnotes, task lists and code blocks become structured GFM. Each slide becomes a section; speaker notes become blockquotes.
any2md.feature4.title: One click to MD to HTML
any2md.feature4.desc: Send the result straight into 100mini's template system — pick one of 9 brand templates and publish a beautiful web page with a share link.
any2md.pain1: No more pip-installing four tools or fighting Python environments
any2md.pain2: Convert PDFs to structured Markdown before feeding LLMs — token costs can drop by orders of magnitude
any2md.pain3: Word/Excel tables survive intact, with merged cells handled correctly
any2md.pain4: PPT content is no longer ignored — slides and notes are fully extracted
any2md.faq1.a: Word (doc/docx), PowerPoint (ppt/pptx), Excel (xls/xlsx), OpenDocument (odt/ods/odp), RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF — 13 in total. Format is auto-detected from content, so even a wrong extension converts correctly.
any2md.faq2.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
any2md.faq2.a: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser; files never leave your device. The only network request is the first-time download of the WASM engine (~3MB, cached afterwards).
any2md.faq3.a: No. This tool does text extraction, not OCR. Image-only scanned PDFs without a text layer will fail.
any2md.faq4.q: How do I get the result out?
any2md.faq4.a: Three ways: download the .md file, copy the full text, or click “Continue to MD to HTML” to bring it into 100mini's template system and publish a web page.
any2md.faq5.q: Is there a file size limit?
any2md.faq5.a: 20MB per file. Very large or long documents will convert noticeably slower, since the browser is single-threaded.
any2md.faq6.q: Are Excel formulas and PPT animations preserved?
any2md.faq6.a: Excel exports computed values, not formulas. PPT extracts text only — animations, videos and transitions are dropped.

pomodoro.guide.what.desc: The Pomodoro Technique is a time management method that breaks work into 25-minute focus sessions, separated by short breaks. After every 4 focus sessions, take a longer break.
pomodoro.guide.step1: Click Start to begin a focus session
pomodoro.guide.step2: Stay focused as the tomato grows — one tomato = 25 min of focus
pomodoro.guide.step3: When the timer rings, take a short break (5 min)
pomodoro.guide.step4: After 4 tomatoes, enjoy a long break (15 min)
pomodoro.guide.step5: Repeat! Log in to track your daily tomatoes 🍅
pomodoro.guide.customize: You can customize focus/break durations and alarm sounds in the Settings menu.
pomodoro.faq1.a: The Pomodoro Technique is a time management method that breaks work into 25-minute focus sessions separated by short breaks. After every 4 focus sessions, take a longer break to maintain productivity.
pomodoro.faq2.q: How long is a Pomodoro session?
pomodoro.faq2.a: By default, each Pomodoro session is 25 minutes of focused work. You can customize the focus duration, short break, and long break in the Settings menu.
pomodoro.faq3.q: How many Pomodoros should I do per day?
pomodoro.faq3.a: It varies by individual. Beginners can start with 4-6 Pomodoros per day, while experienced users typically complete 8-12. The key is maintaining a sustainable rhythm rather than chasing a specific number.
pomodoro.faq4.a: Yes, it is completely free with no sign-up required. Logging in allows you to track your daily completed Pomodoros and monitor your productivity over time.
pomodoro.faq5.q: Can I customize the duration and alarm sounds?
pomodoro.faq5.a: Yes. Click the menu button in the top-left corner to open Settings, where you can adjust the focus duration, short break, and long break, and choose from 5 different alarm melodies.
